_meta.purpose: Single source of truth for switch_on reproduction hyperparameters.
_meta.do_not_modify: These values must match the paper exactly.

task.name: switch_on
task.comment_env_setup: switch=0 means the switch starts in the OFF position (per core/calvin_utils.py limits [0, 0.09]). Success = switch crosses midpoint to the ON side. Matches the released calvin_exp_configs_examples/switch_on.json.
task.comment_reset_poses: Right-side midpoint poses — the robot starts on the right side of the table (where the switch is), midpoint height. Matches the released config.

guidance_hyperparameters.comment: Table 4 row for switch_on. scale=guidance strength (s in Eq. 3), alpha=sigma in Eq. 2 log-sum-exp, M=stochastic-sampling inner-loop repeats.

policy_horizons.comment_Ta: Paper §B.1 says 14 actions executed open-loop before re-querying; the released config has Ta=8 but the modified diffusion_policy.py:658 hardcodes Ta=14 for guidance runs. We use 14.

evaluation_protocol.comment_seeds: Paper averages 6 seeds. We use 3 for budget; report mean ± standard error (sigma/sqrt(n)).
evaluation_protocol.success_criterion: Articulated switch crosses the midpoint of its travel from initial state, per check_state_difference() in core/calvin_utils.py:53.

paper_targets.source: Paper Table 5, 'All Environments' row (the standard DynaGuide setup, full ABCD-trained dynamics model).

baseline_run.comment: Same code path as DynaGuide, with scale=0 the gradient is zero-multiplied out. M=1 means no stochastic-sampling inner loop. This is the 'no guidance' baseline.
